title: Security Architecture Review - AI Pal v1.2.1
framework: OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 + NIST 800-53 r5 + OWASP LLM Top 10 2025

findings.title: Claude Code confined by flag deny-list that omits MCP, hooks, settings, session storage; runs in user config zone
findings.framework_mapping: LLM06; LLM01; NIST AC-6,CM-7,SC-39; ASVS V1.14.1,V1.14.5
findings.recommended_control: Harden flags + empty temp cwd + env allow-list + runtime canary; target dedicated profile

findings.title: Codex read-only sandbox leaves FS readable and loads user config; Kiro only --trust-tools "" and unreviewed
findings.recommended_control: Same isolation plan; add Kiro and Codex to canary; test --ignore-user-config

findings.title: No instruction/data separation: raw concat, forgeable roles/markers, no untrusted-data clause, null system on Custom Prompt, system prompt evictable
findings.evidence: PromptTemplates.java:233,243,253; HttpRequestFormatter.java:15,19,125,129; ChatMessage.java:62-64; ClaudeCodeClient.java:331; CodexClient.java:307; LLMContextMenuProvider.java:174; ConversationHistory.java:28-29,58-59
findings.framework_mapping: LLM01; LLM07; NIST SI-10,SC-7; ASVS V1.5.1,V1.14.1
findings.recommended_control: Nonce fences + untrusted-data clause + structured channels + assume-compromise via SA-001

findings.title: No egress governance: no classification, redaction, minimisation, scope check, consent, preview; destination attribute wrong and unused
findings.recommended_control: Provider data-handling tiers + per-project consent + preview + scope check + default redaction

findings.title: AWS keys persisted plaintext per keystroke; silent 3-source precedence; no SDK chain; wrong profile var; source never shown
findings.recommended_control: Session-memory or OS keychain; opt-in persistence; show account and source before first send

findings.title: Outbound LLM calls traverse Burp HTTP stack (logged, project-persisted, visible to other extensions); two network paths for Ollama
findings.recommended_control: Dedicated HTTP client outside Burp for all provider calls

findings.title: Ollama accepts any host over cleartext http, no auth, redirects followed on streaming path
findings.recommended_control: Cleartext only to loopback; otherwise https or explicit confirmation

findings.title: Shared 3-thread pool with unbounded queue; CLI timeouts never fire; shutdown leaves children
findings.recommended_control: Per-feature bulkheads, watchdog timeouts, bounded queue, tracked child processes

findings.title: CLI tool chain cannot be pinned: no version gate or behaviour check, auto-persisted discovered paths, PATH extended with user-writable dirs, Windows separator bug
findings.recommended_control: Startup capability canary, minimum version gate, explicit path confirmation

findings.title: Conversation/task state has no lifecycle: Clear leaves attachment, in-flight stream repopulates history, tasks unbounded
findings.recommended_control: Single state owner with epoch, cap, purge, unload cleanup

findings.title: No output trust boundary: output treated as authoritative, payload prompt asks for exact payloads, some JOptionPane labels receive server text (plain-text main views are sound)
findings.framework_mapping: LLM05; LLM09; NIST SI-15; ASVS V1.5.4
findings.recommended_control: Provenance banner; escape or avoid HTML-capable labels

findings.title: Error/log channels carry client-derived content into Burp Extensions log
findings.recommended_control: Log length and hash, not content

findings.title: Assurance gap: false "all tools removed" claim in comment, no tests/canary for any security control, stale gitignored docs
findings.recommended_control: Control tests, runtime canary, correct comment and README
